title: The one-question session
lede: Four questions. The last one is optional and in your own words.

items.prompt: What do you sit down with at the start of a paper session?
options: A list of everything on your plate
One really good question, or a few
items.explain: One really good question leads the session.

items.prompt: Put the four pillars in the order the academy teaches them.
Your session ends and the question isn't answered yet. Where does it go?
items.explain: Bank it as the question for your next session instead of chasing it now.

items.prompt: What one question will you bring to your next session, and where did it come from?
items.rubric: Names ONE specific question (not a task list) and says where it came up during their work.
